# Tangerine 1.2
- Fixed video conversion failures caused by auxiliary, unsupported, damaged, or non-primary media tracks. - Improved Balanced video compression to retain substantially more detail while preserving HDR, 10-bit color, and original dimensions when supported. Strong remains available for smaller files. - Added safe handling for odd-sized and oversized video, including high-resolution HEVC sources. - Preserved alternate tracks and subtitles when removing metadata or audio. - Prevented multi-page and multi-frame image conversions from silently dropping pages. - Correctly routes audio-only MOV files to audio conversions and tools. - Improved conversion progress, cancellation, and drag-overlay behavior.

# Tangerine 1.1
- Fixed conversion and compression of newer iPhone MOV recordings containing auxiliary spatial-audio tracks. - Added separate Balanced and Strong video-compression settings, with Balanced as the default for better visual quality. - Improved Settings search so category searches such as video, audio, image, document, and archive show all related formats. - Made Balanced the default image-compression setting. - Removed the purchase button from Settings.
